name: swoole/library-embedded-tests
description: Installs the test tooling for running the test suite against the library embedded in the Swoole extension (swoole.enable_library=On). The main composer.json is not used there: its autoload.files entry (src/vendor_init.php) requires swoole.enable_library=Off and throws when the embedded library is on. This file instead installs a minimal dependency set and registers only the Composer-only namespaces, so the tests exercise the copy embedded in the extension. Composer-only components are not packed into the extension, so Swoole\Grpc, Swoole\Debugger, Swoole\Proxy, Swoole\Kafka, Swoole\FastCGI and Swoole\Coroutine\FastCGI need their own PSR-4 rules here. The Swoole\FastCGI root class sits outside the namespace directory, so src/core/FastCGI.php is listed in the classmap. The gRPC example tests also load examples/grpc/generated and examples/grpc/Etcd, which need google/protobuf. The Kafka broker tests load Swoole\Kafka\Consumer\Assignor\StickyAssignor, which needs chdemko/sorted-collections. Swoole\Kafka\Sasl\AwsMskIamSasl needs aws/aws-sdk-php. Used by the Build Swoole workflow as: COMPOSER=composer-embedded.json composer update
